# AddressInput v0.3.0 - Table of Contents

Loads and queries address metadata derived from the libaddressinput dataset.

## Pages

- [AddressInput](https://address-input.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [AddressInput](https://address-input.hexdocs.pm/AddressInput.md): High-level API for address metadata derived from the
[libaddressinput](https://github.com/google/libaddressinput) dataset.
- [AddressInput.Country](https://address-input.hexdocs.pm/AddressInput.Country.md): Country metadata parsed from the libaddressinput dataset.
- [AddressInput.Subregion](https://address-input.hexdocs.pm/AddressInput.Subregion.md): Subregion metadata parsed from the libaddressinput dataset.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix address_input.update_metadata](https://address-input.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AddressInput.UpdateMetadata.md): Update metadata from the libaddressinput data source.
